_meta.schema: one entry per agent profile, same format as prompt.json: agent_profile carries name/role/capabilities, the character prompt itself is kept verbatim in role, goal, and backstory as defined by the crew projects
_meta.note: Scanned every project under crewai/ (YAML configs and inline Agent(...) definitions). Duplicate copies under crewAI-examples were deduplicated; each entry lists its source file. Keys starting with '_' are the file's own notes, not profiles.
_meta.changes: v1: initial dump of all character prompts from the crew example projects, normalized to the prompt.json profile format.
